Tobias, the only site named in this channel for the stalled label printing is **Southgate**.

Priyanka's 14:06 post from 2025-09-03 says label printing stalled at Tansley Parcel depots, and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Her closing note says labels were printing again and Southgate had cleared the backlog. No other depot is named in the channel. For more detail before the call, Priyanka or Hollis would be the ones to confirm.

I tried to post this as a separate message in the channel too, but the messaging tools here don't have a working route to it, so this reply is the only copy.
